reference.title: Build parameters and configuration
reference.shortdesc: Use DITA-OT parameters to control the build stages, site metadata, theme behavior, highlighting, and Python runtime.

section.title: Plug-in parameters

section.p: Standard DITA-OT and HTML5 parameters also apply, including --filter, args.draft, and args.gen.task.lbl.

section.title: Use a custom Zensical configuration
section.p: Pass a TOML path with -Dzensical.config=site.toml to keep theme, palette, and extension settings under version control. Relative paths resolve from the directory where you run dita; absolute paths are accepted. The plug-in copies the config to out/zensical.toml and adds missing site_name, extra_css, and nav values.
Keep attr_list enabled when setting markdown_extensions. Generated headings use it to preserve DITA IDs. Code highlighting follows the configured pymdownx.highlight settings.

section.title: Python interpreter selection
section.p: Stage 2 runs in the Python environment that provides Zensical, Python-Markdown, pymdownx, and Pygments. The plug-in checks these locations in order:

ol.li: A Python executable beside the zensical command, such as a virtual environment, pipx, or uv tool installation.
The interpreter in the zensical script's shebang.
python3, python, or py on PATH.
